name: John-Michael (JM) Knowles
headline: Vice President Of Professional Services at Salesforce
about:
Mr. Knowles is a Vice President of Services responsible for re-inventing,, leading and organically growing the firm's Northeast business unit, second largest in the global commercial practice. He is a seasoned business and technology leader with over 22 years experience building and motivating high-performing sales teams, owning the Northeast P&L while managing and scaling operations for the NYC office. Mr. Knowles has spent his career building teams and teaching them how to solve complex business challenges and develop an outcome focused rigor to maximize customer success.. He has done this through emphasizing building long lasting collaborative relationships with customers and partners and all internal Salesforce teams. Mr. Knowles has a proven track record of winning and growing accounts, and overseeing the delivery of mission-critical business and technology solutions for Fortune 1000 and high-growth companies. 

In addition to this experience Mr. Knowles has been a consummate utility player, helping mentor emerging leaders across the company and he has held a variety of senior roles including being one of the early leaders in helping shape and influence our Public Sector and State & Local practice, helping co-found our K-12 / Education and Nonprofit practices, and successfully running a portfolio of large accounts in the Mid-Atlantic region. 

Prior to joining Acumen Solutions, Mr. Knowles held several executive and growth oriented roles at a Financial Services start-up which grew to 245 locations and across 13 states.. Additional prior leadership experience was gained during his tenure at Siebel Systems (now Oracle Corporation.) Mr. Knowles held multiple senior roles which helped drive Siebel’s cloud product roadmap and associated sales processes for Siebel’s CRMOnDemand which eventually became Oracle CRM OnDemand.com. Finally Mr. Knowles held multiple roles at a fast-growing start-up straight out of college, which he was employee #37 and grew to 1800 people, went public on the NYSE and was purchased by another company, all of this occurred within a 4 years time period. 

Mr. Knowles is a thoughtful, empathetic team-builder and executive skilled at helping customers solve their most strategic business challenges all the while delivering and exceeding expectations and doing so in a fun, creative and mindful manner.

Specialties:
- Executive Management with P&L Responsibility
- Talent Development
- Customer Success & Strategy
- Digital Transformation
- Business Unit Management
- Account Development
- Engagement Delivery
- Program Management
